title: Run Timelines
description: Query strings below are plain-English-adjacent pseudo-SQL, not copy-paste-ready syntax for any specific Grafana datasource plugin — no real backend/datasource is wired up in this build (Phase 0/3 framing: inert until a backend is eventually started). Source: kind:"run" records (schema run.v1) in ~/.claude/metrics/*.jsonl, written by three real builders: loop_close.py (run_kind:"subagent"), harvest_metrics.py (run_kind:"session"), and dispatch/run.sh (run_kind:"audit") — Phase 2. One row per subagent/session/audit run, grouped by outcome.

panels.title: Recent runs by outcome
panels.description: Source: kind:"run" records in ~/.claude/metrics/*.jsonl. Fields: ts_start, ts_end, run_kind (subagent/session/audit), outcome (success/failure/partial/interrupted), stop_reason, task_id.

targets.query: SELECT ts_start, ts_end, run_kind, outcome, stop_reason, task_id FROM runs ORDER BY ts_start DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Outcome distribution
panels.description: Source: kind:"run" records in ~/.claude/metrics/*.jsonl. Count grouped by outcome.

targets.query: SELECT outcome, count(*) FROM runs GROUP BY outcome

panels.title: Runs by run_kind
panels.description: Source: kind:"run" records in ~/.claude/metrics/*.jsonl. Count grouped by run_kind, showing the split across the three real builders (loop_close.py subagent runs, harvest_metrics.py session runs, dispatch/run.sh audit runs).

targets.query: SELECT run_kind, count(*) FROM runs GROUP BY run_kind
